summary: Firefox’s layout engine gained broad improvements to modern CSS behavior, including automatic, container-size-aware CSS line-clamp, more accurate text-box-trim, grid and flex sizing, sticky positioning, anchor positioning, preserve-3d and backdrop-filter rendering, and position-try-order. It also improves scroll-state preservation, animation throttling, font metrics, generated content, and event dispatching, while removing legacy paths such as CHROME_SCROLLBARS and the old content attr() handling.
